content:
q17.

`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

This module holds the memo CRUD React Query hooks — `useCreateMemo` (`createMemo`, line 183), `useUpdateMemo` (`updateMemo`, line 202), `useDeleteMemo` (`deleteMemo`, line 258), and the list/get queries (`listMemos`, `getMemo`). All of them call through the generated `memoServiceClient`, imported from `@/connect` (`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:5`), which is the Connect-generated client for the `MemoService` (proto type at `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`).
